about: Expected answers of the federation acceptance questions 2 to 6 and the controlled cases, derived from the released files by federation/acceptance/derive_expected.py, never from a run. A test re-derives this file and fails when it differs.

question6.personnel: the commanding officer (when the mission has one) and the assigned crew; the participants are never counted
question6.buckets: confirmed with a senior officer, confirmed without, unconfirmed (never folded into either side)
question6.plannedRule: a PLANNED mission is unconfirmed unless it already has a confirmed senior officer (confirmed with is possible, confirmed without never: its staffing is not final)
question6.cancelledRule: CANCELLED missions are left out of the population and their number is reported beside the answer (cancelledNotCounted), never folded into any bucket; their staffing, their references and their resolutions are not looked at
question6.percentageOf: the confirmed missions: with / (with + without); not a number (null, never 0) when no mission is confirmed

controlledBuckets.rule: the people checked are the commanding officer (when the mission has one) and the assigned crew; with = at least one is confirmed senior; without = every one is confirmed and none senior; unconfirmed = no confirmed senior and at least one not confirmed (UNMAPPED, UNRESOLVED, RELEASE_REFUSED, UNAVAILABLE or a null resolution); a PLANNED mission is unconfirmed unless a confirmed senior is already assigned; a mission with nobody at all is without unless it is PLANNED; a CANCELLED mission is in no bucket
